purpose: Validation thresholds for Arcana skill packages. These values are intentionally strict enough to identify thin or template-like packages, while CI starts in report mode during the repository cleanup phase.
notes: Use python scripts/validate_skills.py for a non-blocking report.
Use python scripts/validate_skills.py --strict after structural cleanup begins.
Use python scripts/validate_skills.py --strict --fail-on-warning for final release-quality checks.
